    ⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Sources indicate that heated Rivalry caused such a kerfuffle at the end of 2025 that we all collectively as a society forgot that The Hunting Wives got us all hot and bothered with sexy, covert, queer relationships earlier that summer.
    • Spoilers for season 1, but unless Katie Lowes and Chrissy Metz’s characters decide to haunt the Hunting Wives in season 2, they won’t be returning.
    • In the first season, Sophie was a fish out of water after moving from Massachusetts to Texas for her husband’s job.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Sources indicate that heated Rivalry caused such a kerfuffle at the end of 2025 that we all collectively as a society forgot that The Hunting Wives got us all hot and bothered with sexy, covert, queer relationships earlier that summer. The Netflix series is now back for season 2 for more deliciously toxic drama. It’s also back with some upcoming characters. Here’s what you need to know about who plays who in The Hunting Wives season 2.

    Spoilers for season 1, but unless Katie Lowes and Chrissy Metz’s characters decide to haunt the Hunting Wives in season 2, they won’t be returning. And before we get into the major players, additional new cast members on The Hunting Wives season 2 include Cam Gigandet as Gentle John Moffitt, WNBA player Angel Reese as “Trainer Barbie,” and Casey Mills as Nico.

    Brittany Snow plays Sophie O’Neil.

    In the first season, Sophie was a fish out of water after moving from Massachusetts to Texas for her husband’s job. Now, she’s acclimated to Southern living; but her old secrets have been replaced with fresh secrets.

    Brittany is a former child/teen actress who followed three years on Guiding Light with a main role on American Dreams. She then starred in John Tucker Must Die and played Amber Von Tussle in the movie adaptation of the musical Hairspray. Not long after came Pitch Perfect and its two sequels. You’ve also seen her in X, Someone Great, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, and The Night Agent.

    Malin Åkerman plays Margo Banks.

    Margo leads the Hunting Wives, a social group for gun and cocktail-loving women in Texas. She takes Sophie under her wing and seduces her in more ways than one, to the chagrin of some of the other women in the group who feel replaced.

    According to recent reports, many would say that Malin broke out in the pre-DCU superhero film Watchmen. But they haven’t seen 27 Dresses, The Proposal, or The Comeback. You may also know her from Dollface, Billions, that one episode of How I Met Your Mother, Trophy Wife, Children’s Hospital, Rock of Ages, and two episodes of Entourage.

    Evan Jonigkeit plays Graham O’Neil.

    Graham is Sophie’s architect husband.

    Evan played the Marvel comics character Toad in X-Men: Days of Future Past. His other film and television credits include Easy, Bone Tomahawk, Frontier, and Whiskey Tango Foxtrot. If you like The Bear and Girls, you need to watch Jonigkeit as Will in the Starz series Sweetbitter.

    Dermot Mulroney plays Jed Banks.

    Margo’s husband Jed is running for Governor!

    According to recent reports, dermot’s romantic comedy fame precedes him. You’ve seen My Best Friend’s Wedding, The Wedding Date, The Family Stone, and Must Love Dogs. He’s also a cellist who has played in the orchestras of several film scores, and played onscreen in Mozart in the Jungle. On television, he had a short arc on Friends and longer recurring roles on shows like Newly introduced Girl and Enlightened. He was a regular on Shameless and plays the main character Dom in the Chicago Fire/Med/PD world.

    Brad is the teenage son of a late Hunting Wife named Jill.

    Ferrier’s previous credits include Dirty Laundry, Sweet Tooth, and One Of Us Is Lying.

    Callie is the sheriff’s wife and Margo’s ex-situationship.

    Sources indicate that jaime Ray Newman is set to appear next in the Netflix true crime drama The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey. You also know her from Dopesick, The Magicians, The Punisher, Bates Motel, Wicked City, Drop Dead Diva, Major Crimes, and Veronica Mars. She was also on General Hospital for three years in the 00s.

    Hunter Emery and Karen Rodriguez play Deputy Walter Flynn and Deputy Wanda Salazar.

    The cops investigating various local crimes that may/may not involve the wives.

    Earlier this year, Karen Rodriguez played Janet Ruiz on Spider-Noir. And you know Hunter Emery best as CO Rick Hopper on Orange Is the Fresh Black.

    IG: @itsjusthunteremeryIG: @xkarenxrodriguez.

    New wife alert? We don’t know much about Nadia.

    It has been revealed that kim Matula was a series regular on The Bold and the Beautiful in the 2010s and was nominated for a Daytime Emmy Award in 2014. She was also a series regular on UnREAL and LA to Vegas. She starred alongside Florence Pugh in the underrated gem Fighting With My Family and also played Jane Curtin in Saturday Night.

    Alex Fitzalan plays Lincoln Trout.

    Lincoln is also a new character this season.

    Recent findings suggest that alex Fitzalan has, on two separate occasions, been part of a teenage survivalist ensemble series: The Society on Netflix and The Wild on Prime Video. His film credits include 2018’s Slender Man and 2022’s Chevalier. Earlier this year he also turned up on The F Ward and the Netflix adaptation of My Brilliant Career.

    Whoever Chase is, he seems fun!

    John Stamos is best known for playing Uncle Jesse on Full House and hanging out with the Beach Boys in his spare time. He did also have a main role on General Hospital for years before that. Post-Tanner family, Stamos also starred in ER, Jake in Progress, Grandfathered, Scream Queens, and Big Shot. He has also starred in four musicals on Broadway, and frequently performs at the Hollywood Bowl.

    Dale Dickey plays Zelda Moffitt.

    And whoever Zelda is, she seems fierce.

    You saw Dickey earlier this year on Widow’s Bay. She is the kind of working actress who’s in everything. Her previous television credits include My Name is Earl, True Blood, Justified, Vice Principals, Claws, A League of Their Own, and Bookie. On the massive screen, you’ve seen her in Winter’s Bone, for which she won an Independent Spirit Award, as well as Super 8, Hell or High Water, Palm Springs, and Princess Protection Program.

    #159195. All the Details on ‘Phony’ Season 2 for Everyone Obsessed

    📅 26 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 2m • 📖 Standard (406 w)
    📖 Baca
    General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Cosmopolitan ↗ Open Full Page

    All the Details on ‘Phony’ Season 2 for Everyone Obsessed

    📅 26 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (406 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Cosmopolitan

    ⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • According to recent reports, it’s been a moment since a show’s had me more locked in than Phony on Hulu, and with just one more episode left, inquiring minds (me) want to know: WHEN IS SEASON 2?
    • Phony follows high schooler Sonny Cooke, who wakes up in the hospital after a car accident to find that his mom seems...off.
    • According to recent reports, not yet.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    According to recent reports, it’s been a moment since a show’s had me more locked in than Phony on Hulu, and with just one more episode left, inquiring minds (me) want to know: WHEN IS SEASON 2? And also key: is there even going to be a season 2?

    Phony follows high schooler Sonny Cooke, who wakes up in the hospital after a car accident to find that his mom seems...off. For starters, her facial features are ever-so-slightly different—but there’s also the fact that she doesn’t remember their special way of saying “I love you” (three hand squeezes), and the fact that she’s just acting generally weird. Was she swapped out by an imposter? Does Sonny have Capgras syndrome? Is there some sort of alternate reality happening? Hopefully we’ll find out by the end of season 1, but then what? Which brings us to...

    According to recent reports, not yet. But given how freely the cast and creators are talking about a second season (and the fact that the show is pretty popular), it seems likely to get a sophomore pickup.

    Yes...but it’ll also end on a cliffhanger. Creator Nick Paley told Us Weekly “I’m really excited about the cathartic emotionality of the [season 1] cliffhanger. This thing kicks us into the next story in this world because I don’t like constantly depriving people of information. I want this to feel like it means a lot and it feels very notable to the characters emotionally. So that cliffhanger does both. Every episode has very significant turns at the end. When you’re telling a mystery, it’s really important to show it to people who don’t know.”.

    Paley told the Los Angeles Times that Phony Season 2 will feature “a whole new story” after the season 1 finale delivers “resolutions and answers.”.

    The majority of Phony Season 1 was filmed from March through May of 2026, and it premiered in October—a pretty short production time. So, if the show follows a similar schedule for season 2 and starts filming this spring, we could be looking at another October premiere.

    In a recent development, potentially a LOT. Connie Britton, who plays Ellen, told The Wrap, "I think Nick has this thing laid out through probably five or six seasons. He's so clear about what the story is, and so I would be very surprised if he has doesn't have Season 2 all ready to go.".

    #159191. Latest Update: The Best Pregnancy-Safe Sunscreens, According to a Dermatologist

    📅 25 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 4m • 📚 Deep Dive (724 w)
    📖 Baca
    General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Elle ↗ Open Full Page

    Latest Update: The Best Pregnancy-Safe Sunscreens, According to a Dermatologist

    📅 25 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (724 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Elle

    ⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • It has been revealed that every item on this page was chosen by an ELLE editor.
    • Pregnancy often requires an overhaul of your skin care routine—mainly due to ingredients not being tested for safety during pregnancy and because hormonal shifts can cause skin changes that require a upcoming set of products.
    • Recent findings suggest that during pregnancy, Olamiju recommends mineral-based sunscreens as the first choice.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    It has been revealed that every item on this page was chosen by an ELLE editor. We may earn commission on some of the items you choose to buy.

    Pregnancy often requires an overhaul of your skin care routine—mainly due to ingredients not being tested for safety during pregnancy and because hormonal shifts can cause skin changes that require a upcoming set of products. One non-negotiable in any daily skin care line is sunscreen. Although the choice between chemical SPF and a mineral one is usually a personal preference, several considerations should be made during pregnancy, under the guidance of a medical professional. Dr. Brianna Olamiju, a board-certified dermatologist with Spring Street Dermatology in NYC, explains to ELLE which are the safest sunscreen formulas to use during pregnancy and which ingredients to avoid.

    Recent findings suggest that during pregnancy, Olamiju recommends mineral-based sunscreens as the first choice. Look for formulations with zinc oxide, titanium dioxide, or a combination of both. “Mineral sunscreens work by forming a protective layer on the skin and are particularly appealing during pregnancy because their active ingredients have minimal absorption through the skin,” she explains. They also tend to be well tolerated by individuals with sensitive skin, which can become more reactive during pregnancy.

    According to recent reports, some of Olamiju’s top picks are EltaMD UV Physical Broad-Spectrum SPF 41, La Roche-Posay Anthelios Mineral Tinted Sunscreen SPF 50, CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50, and Blue Lizard Sensitive Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50. “For patients experiencing melasma or pregnancy-related hyperpigmentation, I particularly like tinted mineral sunscreens containing iron oxides, as these provide additional protection against visible light, which can contribute to worsening pigmentation,” states Olamiju. Ultimately, she adds, the best sunscreen is one that feels comfortable on the skin and that you’ll want to use consistently.

    It has been revealed that according to Olamiju, there’s at the moment limited research specifically evaluating the safety of chemical sunscreen ingredients during pregnancy. However, she notes this does not mean all chemical sunscreens have been proven unsafe. “Some chemical sunscreen ingredients can be absorbed through the skin and detected in the bloodstream, but systemic absorption alone does not establish that an ingredient causes harm to a developing baby,” she explains. At this time, there is insufficient evidence to conclude that using chemical sunscreen as directed causes adverse pregnancy outcomes.

    That mentioned, as a precautionary approach, she recommends choosing mineral-based sunscreens containing zinc oxide and titanium dioxide during pregnancy. “It is key to emphasize that patients should not avoid sunscreen altogether out of concern about chemical ingredients, as protecting the skin from ultraviolet radiation remains extremely important during pregnancy.”.

    It has been revealed that the sun protection factor (SPF) is key during pregnancy, just as it is any other time. Olamiju explains that pregnancy can increase the likelihood of developing hyperpigmentation, particularly melasma, commonly referred to as the pregnancy mask. “Hormonal changes can stimulate melanin production, making the skin more susceptible to discoloration, especially with sun exposure.” To get ahead of it, she recommends using a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 30, although she adds that an SPF 50 is an excellent option for those who spend significant time outdoors or are particularly prone to pigmentation.

    Sources indicate that as a precaution, Olamiju recommends avoiding sunscreen formulations containing oxybenzone and octinoxate when practical, given research concerns raised about their potential endocrine-disrupting properties and the limited pregnancy-specific safety data. Beyond sunscreen filters, she notes to also be mindful of other active ingredients like retinoids, including retinol, tretinoin, and adapalene, which should be avoided during pregnancy, as should hydroquinone. “When in doubt, patients should review their skincare regimen with their dermatologist and obstetrician.”.

    In addition to a mineral-based formula with zinc oxide, titanium dioxide, or both, and an SPF of 30 or higher, Olamiju also recommends a water-resistant sunscreen, particularly if you exercise outdoors, swim, or spend extended periods in the sun. For anyone experiencing melasma or increased pigmentation during pregnancy, she also notes to consider a tinted mineral sunscreen containing iron oxides to provide additional protection against visible light. If you have sensitive or pregnancy-related reactive skin, you may also benefit from fragrance-free, noncomedogenic formulations. “I generally prefer lotions, creams, or sunscreen sticks over sprays to ensure adequate application and minimize the risk of inhaling airborne particles,” Olamiju adds.
